newsitem.title: UK: Sterling dominates easier UK grain futures.
newsitem.headline: Sterling dominates easier UK grain futures.

text.p: Sterling's early strength then a decline against other European currencies dominated trading on the UK grain futures market on Tuesday.
"Wheat futures dropped by around one stg as sterling hit 2.50 marks but came off the bottom when sterling fell back slightly," said a trader.
Traders said there was also a certain amount of support at the lower levels.
Wheat futures closed 0.40 to 0.75 stg down after trading 462 lots while barley was 0.50 to 0.75 stg lower on 42 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were tradeless.
UK delivered market traders reported an active morning but trade fizzled out as the futures came of the lows.
In East Anglia feed wheat was fetching between 96.50 and 95.50 stg a tonne for November while material in the New Year was trading at 98 stg.

In the west of England 98.50 stg was paid for Jan/Mar feed wheat. Milling wheat in East Anglia was trading at 114 and 115 stg for Nov. Fob business was reported at 100 stg for Apr/Jun ex-east coast ports.
